area_24: Sicherheit und Geborgenheit sind von zentraler Bedeutung für das Wohlbefinden der Menschen. Sicherheit vor Gewalt – sei es im öffentlichen Raum, zu Hause oder im Internet – ist eine Grundvoraussetzung für ein Leben in Würde. In unsicheren Umgebungen schränken Angst und Risiko die Mobilität ein, begrenzen die wirtschaftliche Aktivität und untergraben das Vertrauen. Zudem sind nicht alle Gruppen gleichermaßen von den Belastungen durch Unsicherheit betroffen; Frauen und schutzbedürftige Gruppen sind oft erhöhten Risiken ausgesetzt. Wo die öffentliche Sicherheit schwach ist, greifen diejenigen, die über die entsprechenden Mittel verfügen, auf privaten Schutz zurück, was die Ungleichheit weiter vertieft.

en.area_24: Safety and security are central to how people experience well-being. Safety from violence – whether in public spaces, at home or online – is a basic condition for leading a dignified life. In insecure contexts, fear and exposure to risk constrain mobility, limit economic activity and erode trust. In addition, the burdens of insecurity do not affect all groups equally, with women and vulnerable groups often facing heightened risks. Where public security is weak, those with resources resort to private protection, deepening inequality.

footer_fields.label: Notes
footer_fields.value:
Number of victims per 100,000 inhabitants (V/100,000): Number of victims per 100,000 inhabitants, based on the population on 31 December of the previous year. Up to and including 2012, the data is based on the 1987 census (Federal Republic of Germany) and the population register as of 3 October 1990 (German Democratic Republic); for the years 2013 to 2023, it is based on the 2011 census, and from 2024 onwards, it is based on the 2022 census.
  • For victims recorded in the reporting year, the year in which the offence was committed may also be prior to the reporting year (initial statistics). Persons who were recorded as victims multiple times in the reporting year are counted multiple times accordingly.

footer_fields.label: Notes
footer_fields.value:
The calculation is based on the retroactively calculated average population. For 2010, this was determined on the basis of the 2011 census and migration, birth and death statistics; for 2012 to 2021, it was determined analogously on the basis of the 2022 census.
  • For victims recorded in the reporting year, the year in which the offence was committed may also be prior to the reporting year (initial statistics). Persons who were recorded as victims multiple times in the reporting year are counted multiple times accordingly.
